# Official pricing fixtures

Selected tables captured on 2026-11-03 from:

- https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing.md
- https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing.md

OpenAI includes Standard and discounted tables to check that the parser selects
the correct processing tier and short-context columns. Anthropic includes
model-specific cache prices, retired models and conditional context tiers.
These fixtures are offline contract examples; live checks use the official
documents rather than this directory.
